name: THSV StreamBridge - Face Filters
author: surakage
description: One broker-authorized, triggerless action that turns on a Streamfog face lens by name for a bounded duration.

actions.name: THSV Extension - Face Filters - Activate Lens

triggerSafety: Activate Lens must remain triggerless. StreamBridge supplies a one-use broker token, one Streamfog lens name, and a 5-600 second duration.
verificationStatus: The Streamfog Activate Lens by Name sub-action (type 37004, lensName and duration fields) was copied from a creator-built Streamer.bot 1.1.0 action; live lens activation remains creator acceptance-tested.
